name: pillow
description: Imaging for Bantu, in the shape of Python's Pillow — written entirely in Bantu over numba's native arrays. This build (phase P4 of 9) covers the Image object, all 20 Pillow modes, the conversion matrix, ImageColor and ImagePalette, the six resampling filters with resize/rotate/transpose/thumbnail/reduce/transform, ImageTransform and ImagePath, the plugin registry, and PNG, BMP, TGA and PPM read and write, plus DEFLATE/zlib/gzip in both directions. Fidelity is differential, not aspirational: 177 of 191 conversion pairs and all 378 resize reference images are byte-identical to Pillow, RGB-to-L is verified over all 16,777,216 triples, and PngSuite — the canonical 176-file PNG conformance corpus — decodes 162 of 162 readable files pixel-identically with all 14 corrupt files refused. A full-frame 1080p operation is about a tenth of a second and a crop or a transpose is free, because no loop is proportional to the pixel count. JPEG, the operation surface, drawing and the remaining formats land in P5-P8; see pillow-suite/ROADMAP.md.
